networkPolicy.desc: Tag Manager, YouTube and Facebook are blocked; maps, search and routes stay open

notes:
Written from the binary and a short trace on a device. What it needs: mapeak.com (its API and tiles), api.openstreetmap.org and overpass-api.de, www.wikidata.org, raw.githubusercontent.com. Blocked: Google Tag Manager and Analytics, the embedded YouTube help video, Facebook.

userContentHosts: images.mapeak.com, the project's own photo server; api.panoramax.xyz, street level photos users take, where people can appear; Wikimedia (upload, commons), inature.info, imgur and nakeb.co.il, as in Israel Hiking Map. Panoramax images may also come from the hosts of its federated instances, which the code does not name; not yet seen on a device.
